Classic Teen Patti – The Foundation

This is the version most people grow up playing.

 

Each player gets three cards. Hand rankings from strongest to weakest are:

  • Trail (three of a kind)
  • Pure Sequence (straight flush)
  • Sequence (straight)
  • Colour (flush)
  • Pair
  • High Card

Players can play blind or seen. Blind players bet less but risk more; seen players pay more to stay in. The pot builds until someone folds or a showdown decides the winner. On Stars777 this mode is usually the most populated, perfect if you want the familiar rhythm without extra rules.

Muflis (Lowball) – When the Worst Hand Wins

Muflis flips everything. The lowest hand takes the pot. A high-card hand with small values suddenly becomes powerful, while a Trail of Aces is almost useless.

This variation rewards tight, careful play and a different kind of bluffing. Many Indian players love Muflis during long sessions because it feels fresh after hours of regular Teen Patti. On Stars777 you will often find dedicated Muflis tables running at different stake levels.

AK47 – Wild Cards Everywhere

In AK47, every Ace, King, 4, and 7 acts as a wild card. That means strong hands appear much more frequently. Trails and pure sequences become common, so the game moves faster and pots grow bigger.

Strategy shifts heavily toward reading how many wilds are in play and deciding when a “good” hand is actually strong enough. This is one of the most popular high-action variations on Stars777 Teen Patti Games because the excitement stays high from the first deal.

Joker Variation – Random Wilds Keep Things Unpredictable

Before or during the hand, one or more ranks (or specific cards) are declared jokers. Any matching card in your hand can substitute for whatever you need.

Because the joker changes, no two rounds feel the same. Players who enjoy adapting on the fly usually prefer this mode. Stars777 typically offers both fixed-joker and random-joker tables so you can choose your preferred level of chaos.

Best of Four – More Cards, More Decisions

Instead of three cards, you receive four and must choose the best three-card combination. This reduces pure luck a bit and rewards better hand selection and observation of opponents’ betting patterns.

It is a favourite among players who like a slight skill edge while still keeping the classic three-card feel. Available on many Stars777 tables, especially during peak evening hours.

Other Variations You May Encounter

  • Hukam – A trump suit is declared; cards of that suit beat everything else of the same rank.
  • 999 – Cards are valued numerically and the goal is to get closest to 9 (or multiples). Face cards often count as zero.
  • Occasional house or seasonal modes that appear during festivals or special promotions.
